keen: p_j,t = elig_j [e expit(A + B + C Covid_t) + (1 - e) expit(A + C Covid_t)], core migrants only
receipt: E[expit(alpha + beta_k Keen + delta FarFam (+ eta need))], Keen Poisson-binomial (exact), FarFam = number of kin links (not gated)
count_mapping: none: index on expected receiving households, compared with Banxico counts directly
calibration: ML on 2019 MMP receipt (remus == 1, e0.target_mask), 2019 CPS employment, Covid = 0
A_pinned: mean 2019 core keen probability = expit(M1 alpha_core) = 0.4421

fit.criterion: quarterly log RMSE over hm.FIT_Q, C in [0, C_max] bounded scalar, 2022 held out
